summary: MaintUserStudent manages student user accounts in HSPnet, including creation, updates, password changes, and support comments. The implementation includes web forms, validations, SSO support, email notifications, password strength indicators, and administrative controls.
purpose: The purpose of MaintUserStudent is to allow administrators and system users to add, update, and manage student user accounts, including handling SSO status, sending emails for account creation/password changes, and recording support comments.

fields.name: active
fields.description: Indicates if the user account is enabled.

workflows.name: Add Student User
steps: Generate new password (minimum 12 characters, mix of cases, symbols, digits)
Send account creation email if IssueEmail is true

workflows.name: Update Student User
steps: Send modification email if IssueEmail is true
Handle edge cases for SSOUPN presence

workflows.name: Change Student Password
steps: Apply password strength indicators and validators
Send password change email if IssueEmail is true and email is present
Display warning about password change status

workflows.name: Edit Support Comment
steps: Update UI class based on comment existence

business_rules: UserName must be unique for student users.
Email must be valid and not empty.
Password must be at least 12 characters and contain upper/lower case, number, and symbol.
SSO enabled accounts do not receive User ID/password emails or allow password changes via UI.
Support comments are only editable by System Administrators.
validations: UserName: required, must not duplicate existing user.
NewPassword: required, must match regular expressions for minimum length, mixed characters.
PasswordStrength: minimum numeric, symbol, upper/lower case requirements.
calculations: GenerateNewPassword: Algorithm to create secure password (12 characters).
conditions: If SSO is enabled, IssueEmail and password change controls are hidden and disabled.
If UserId is 0, show Create User interface.
If account is disabled, hide Change Password button.
If SSOUPN is present or absent, show specific warnings.
system_behavior: Hides/show controls based on user/SSO status.
Sends emails on creation/update/password change if IssueEmail is true and email is present.
Records warnings and errors in UserSession.Messages.
Manages support comments in modal popups.
exceptions: StudentPasswordChange_NoEmail: No email present for password change.
SSO_StudentUser_Modified_Without_SsoUPN: SSO user modified without SSOUPN.
